verdict.rationale: Jira's own docs describe tracking progress from tools like Slack, connecting tools such as Bitbucket and Slack through automation, and offering 3,000+ Marketplace integrations, so native connection to common tools is documented. Of the three named tools, only Slack is explicitly covered, and many Marketplace integrations may be third-party apps rather than native ones. Missing for 10: explicit native GitHub integration, explicit Google Drive integration, setup/depth documentation, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can connect common tools like Slack, GitHub, and Google Drive natively

citations.quote: Keep work up-to-date by tracking progress from your favorite tools like Slack, Figma and Gmail
Whether your team is using Bitbucket, Slack, or any other tool, automation keeps Jira up to date, so you don't have to.
Choose from the over 3000+ integrations available in the Atlassian Marketplace.
